01 / THE BRIEF

A system, not a website.

VMS is the Venue Management System at vms.xpert-safety.com. It is where venue information, audits and infrastructure details are captured, filtered and managed by authorised admins.

The challenge was less about how it looks and more about how it behaves: who can log in, what they can see, and how data travels cleanly from a form to the database and back.

ReactViteJavaScriptREST APIsAuth ContextProtected RoutesDatabase integration
“A good admin tool gets out of the way and lets people finish their work.”
THE BUILD PRINCIPLE
02 / WHAT I BUILT

Built end to end.

I worked across the interface, the API layer and the data flow: from the login screen through to the dashboard and the operational modules behind it.

  • Authentication flow: login, AuthContext and ProtectedRoute guarding the dashboard.
  • Admin dashboard with modules for venue management, venue audit, CCTV information, infrastructure, laboratory and PPT venue.
  • Filters, forms and validation, with data submitted through REST APIs to the backend.
Login→Authentication→AuthContext→ProtectedRoute→Dashboard
WHAT THIS PROJECT BROUGHT TOGETHER

Auth & access

Login flow, shared auth state and protected routes.

Operational modules

Venue, audit, CCTV, infrastructure and lab sections.

API integration

Forms, validation and data submission over REST.

03 / THE TAKEAWAY

What it
taught me.

Authentication and routing bugs are the ones that hurt most in production. Debugging the login-to-dashboard flow properly taught me to treat auth as a first-class feature, not an afterthought.
